flyer.justification: The flyer meets all formatting rules, including title length and placeholder logistics, while accurately conveying the core message.

instagram.justification: The caption fulfills all requirements including visual carousel cues, emojis, call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary perfectly adheres to all structural constraints and stays well under the 400-word limit.

blog.justification: The blog misses multiple required structural elements, including numbered sections and a comparison/takeaway table.
